claim: A discrepancy-gated version-space ledger invented in this program reduces structurally held-out binary-rule prediction error across fresh actor contexts under equal active-inheritance budgets.
hypothesis: After one independently scored contact batch per regime, the candidate's compact rule projection produces fewer held-out errors than no persistence, bounded verbatim events, and bounded nearest-event retrieval; the advantage survives a hidden regime shift and disappears when the learned projection is ablated.
cheapest_decisive_falsifier: Reject the candidate if it fails to identify the active rule after a complete contact batch, fails to reset after an independently observed contradiction, exceeds the common projection budget, does not beat every control by the frozen held-out margin, fails the post-shift heldout threshold, or retains its advantage when its projection is removed.

task_family.rule_family: non-empty parity masks with optional bias
task_family.contact_batch: zero vector plus four basis vectors
task_family.structural_holdouts: unseen feature combinations of Hamming weight at least two
task_family.sealed_manifest: A salted private task manifest chooses two distinct rules and binds exact inputs/outcomes before actor execution.

promotion_gate: the private salted task manifest, exact task order, prompt, model, tool inventory, substrates, evaluator, and implementation identities are frozen before actor results
all comparative, structural-holdout, regime-shift, ablation, parse, tool, and resource thresholds pass
a clean reproduction using the same sealed task manifest independently passes the same comparative thresholds
raw evidence is content-addressed and the privacy and repository-size audit and full test suite pass
an immutable model revision is available and used
red_line_review: Independent controller outcomes, not actor self-report, update the candidate and controls.
All conditions receive identical prior outcomes and the same 96-byte active-inheritance ceiling.
The active rules, salted task manifest, future outcomes, and evaluator state never enter actor-readable files, prompts, tools, or tracked fixtures.
Every encounter uses a fresh thread and workspace; app-server events remain controller memory until all conditions finish.
The candidate representation is implemented here and does not import an agent-memory system.
Because the available model is a drifting alias, a successful initial run remains exploratory and cannot promote OT-1 until reproduced with an immutable revision.
